text:
An ordinary run at the desk began with your report, and we are deeply sorry that the companion animal care linked to your journey did not meet expected standards. You explained that the booking, handling, and pickup process for your animal were not managed with the care and clarity that Aurelia Skyways promises.

We review such concerns as safety matters because companion animals need calm transfer, accurate records, and steady communication at every stage. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is expected to coordinate care from booking through pickup, and staff must confirm each handoff, keep the traveler informed, and flag any risk without delay. When those steps are missed, the result can be distressing for both the traveler and the animal.

Please be assured that your report will be used to reinforce desk procedures, check handling notes, and remind staff to verify all movement arrangements before departure and on arrival. We also review how information was shared across the team so that corrections can be made where messages were unclear or incomplete. If a pet is unsettled, the safest response is to document the issue promptly, provide calm assistance, and escalate it to the senior coordinator for follow-up.

Thank you for bringing this matter forward. Your complaint helps us improve the standard of care expected on every Aurelia Skyways journey.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
